tema: un paseo de otono por el Retiro, Madrid
idea: Un paseo otoñal por El Retiro disfrutando de la magia de Madrid
texto: Madrid en otoño tiene ese no sé qué que me vuelve loca. 🍂 Entre hojas caídas y un cafecito mental, este parque siempre es mi refugio favorito. Booby y los michis tendrían que ver esto (bueno, o quedarse durmiendo en el sofá, seamos sinceros). ¿Cuál es vuestro rincón favorito de la capi para desconectar?
escenas: The same woman, medium shot from the waist up in El Retiro park, Madrid, during a golden autumn afternoon. She is wearing an oversized beige knit sweater and a dark scarf. Gentle sunlight filtering through orange and yellow leaves, smiling softly with lips closed, looking slightly away from the camera.

The same woman, upper-body shot in El Retiro park, Madrid, autumn season. She wears the same oversized beige knit sweater and dark scarf. Soft backlit sunlight, leaning against an old stone bench, smiling with lips together, looking directly at the camera.

The same woman, close-up shot in El Retiro park, Madrid, golden hour lighting. Wearing the same oversized beige knit sweater and dark scarf. Surrounded by blurred autumn foliage, gentle expression with a soft closed-mouth smile, relaxed pose.
